sections.title: Classroom Discourse
sections.description: This seminar invites students to grapple with the question of ‘Why Classroom Discussion Matters?”’ Drawing from readings in philosophy, learning theory, and empirical research on discussion-focused classroom interventions and teacher professional development, we will consider the purposes of and challenges to open classroom discourse.
